authHeroDescription: From raw materials to finished products, keep your team and production moving together.
loginDescription: Sign in to your factory workspace.
accountHelp: Need an account or a different permission? Contact your factory administrator.
invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
connectionError: We could not connect. Check your connection and try again.
logoutFailed: You are signed out on this device, but the server could not confirm logout. Reconnect and sign out again to end the server session.
recoveryDescription: Enter your work email to receive a password reset code.
recoverySent: If your account is available, a reset code has been sent. Check your inbox.
recoveryError: We could not send a code. Check the email or wait before trying again.
passwordRequirements: Use at least 8 characters, including uppercase and lowercase letters, and a number or symbol.
checkFields: Check your email, six-digit code, and password requirements.
resetError: The code may have expired. Check it or request a new code.
passwordReset: Your password has been updated. You can now sign in.
homeDescription: Your account and factory workflow, together in one place.
productionJourneyDescription: Four stages, with a clear handover at every step.
mixingDescription: Approve materials, dispense stock, mix, and check the bulk product.
packagingDescription: Prepare packaging, fill and seal, then confirm the finished quantity.
qualityDescription: Hand over samples and complete the final quality checks.
routingDescription: Receive finished goods into storage or prepare direct dispatch.
yourWorkspaceDescription: Areas assigned to your factory role. These sections will open in the next phase.
accessDeniedDescription: Your role does not have permission to open this page.
pageNotFoundDescription: This page may have moved or the address may be incorrect.
productionDescription: Track production batches, stages, target quantities, and planned work.
recipesDescription: Review the protected formulas used to produce finished agricultural chemistry products.
inventoryDescription: See available and reserved stock for each item and factory branch.
purchasingDescription: Follow purchase orders, suppliers, delivery dates, and order values.
suppliersDescription: Maintain the approved companies and contacts that supply factory materials.
catalogDescription: Review raw materials, packaging supplies, and finished products.
employeesDescription: Manage factory employees, positions, branches, and account status.
branchesDescription: Review factory branches, locations, managers, and operating status.
loadError: The records could not be loaded. Check the backend connection and your permission.
name: Name
categoriesDescription: Organize factory items into clear material and product categories.
transactionsDescription: Audit every stock movement, responsible employee, branch, and quantity.
notificationsDescription: Review unread workflow alerts and factory updates assigned to your role.
notificationsPageDescription: Review workflow alerts, mark them as read, or dismiss them from your account.
noNotificationsDescription: Factory alerts assigned to you will appear here.
title: Title
dashboardDescription: Live totals from the factory areas available to your role.
trashDescription: Deleted records stay here until an authorized user restores them.
adjustInventoryDescription: Record an authorized stock movement for an item and branch.
duplicateRecord: A record with the same code already exists.
saveError: The record could not be saved. Check the fields and try again.
productionWorkspaceDescription: Manage production batches from mixing through storage or dispatch.
createBatchDescription: Choose the recipe, factory branch, planned quantity, and employee who receives the first permit task.
employeeFormHelp: Enter the employee account details. Each message below a field explains exactly what must be corrected.
employeeNameEnRequired: Enter the employee name in English.
employeeNameArRequired: Enter the employee name in Arabic.
employeeEmailInvalid: Enter a valid work email, for example name@company.com.
employeePhoneInvalid: Enter an Egyptian mobile number such as 01012345678 or +201012345678.
employeePasswordOptional: Optional — leave blank to keep the current password
employeePasswordInvalid: The password must contain at least 8 characters.
employeeSalaryInvalid: Salary cannot be less than zero.
employeeFormInvalid: Correct the highlighted employee fields before saving.
employeeDuplicateError: Another employee already uses this email address or phone number.
positiveQuantityRequired: Enter a quantity greater than zero.
bilingualNotesHelp: Notes are optional. If entered, provide both English and Arabic.
completeTasksBeforeAdvance: Complete every task in this stage before the operations manager advances it manually.
assignedToAnotherEmployee: This task is assigned to another employee.
noPendingTask: All tasks in this stage are complete.
manualAdvanceHelp: Available after every task in the current stage is complete.
handoverRequired: Select the employee who will receive the next task.
deleteError: The record could not be deleted. Please try again.
recipePercentageBelow: Raw materials must total at least 100% before saving.
recipePercentageWarningText: This recipe will reserve and consume more raw material than its production target. Current total:
categoryCodeInstruction: Only alphanumeric characters, dashes, and underscores allowed.
bilingualNotesRequired: Please provide notes in both English and Arabic.
confirmReleaseUnusedReservations: Close this batch as failed and release only the unused reservations listed above? Dispensed materials will remain out of stock.
dispatchClosedFailed: Batch closed as failed. Unshipped finished goods remain in branch stock.
dispatchReservationMissing: No finished goods are reserved for this batch. The accountant cannot ship it until the operation manager verifies the stock.
reconcileDispatchConfirm: I have checked the physical finished goods for this batch. Record any missing batch receipt and reserve its packaged yield for dispatch. This changes inventory stock and reservations.

formInvalid: Please correct the highlighted fields before saving.
recipeNeedsIngredients: Recipe must have at least one ingredient.
purchasingNeedsComponents: Purchase order must have at least one item.
capacityInvalid: Capacity must be a positive number.
capacityUomRequired: Capacity unit is required when capacity is set.
minimumAlertLevelInvalid: Minimum alert level must be a positive number.
averageCostPriceInvalid: Average cost price must be a positive number.
sellingPriceInvalid: Selling price must be a positive number.
advancementDisabledOnHold: Advancement is disabled while the batch is on hold.
batchOnHoldContactManager: This batch is on hold. Contact the operations manager for assistance.
